$comment: Claude Agent SDK MCP servers: `query({ prompt, options: { mcpServers: { name: { type: "http" | "sse", url, headers } } } })`. The app does not connect itself: the Claude Code process `query` starts does, with the configuration the app gives, so each HTTP server is still an outbound connection of the app. Servers with a `command` (stdio) or of type `sdk` (`createSdkMcpServer`, in process) send no HTTP request and are not reported. The model requests of `query` are `claude-agent-sdk.json`'s.
